caption: The drawing shows a single wooden rocking chair oriented to the left side of the image. The rocking chair has a curved wooden frame in a reddish-brown color, with smoothly arched armrests and runners. The chair includes a padded backrest and seat, both covered in a medium brown fabric. The backrest is high and gently sloped, matching the cushion for the seat, which is thick and slightly rounded. The chair also features a small, light-colored wooden footrest attached to the front, which appears to be fixed at an angle. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or decorations present.
title: Invalid's Chair
